purpose: Read-only feasibility and proposed isolated validation; not approval to install or serve
recommendation: First evaluate the official Alpheios XML CLI and its own pinned Greek stemlib in a disposable restricted Linux container. Keep all offline results separate from existing hosted-service receipts and live corpus. This removes network dependence without consuming or bypassing hosted quotas. It does not solve contextual disambiguation or dictionary joining automatically.

Do not mislabel this fork or stem data MPL simply because a different fork is MPL. Preserve all notices and source provenance. This is a source-notice inventory, not a blanket redistribution/legal conclusion.

primary_candidate.initial_experiment_data_policy: Compile the executable from source and initially use the already compiled pinned dist/stemlib bytes for parser parity. The repository includes historical .o/.a/executable files: inspect clean rules and require a proven full source rebuild, not accidental reuse of checked-in build outputs. Do not silently rebuild or combine a different fork's data. A reconstructed stemlib is a separately fingerprinted experiment.

adapter_cautions: Preserve source Unicode and exact token offsets; record Beta Code transport separately with adapter version and mapping provenance.
Use the documented terminal elision convention; never silently strip apostrophes, accents, underdots, lacunae or reconstructed letters.

Alpheios wrapper has optional apostrophe stripping fallback, remote lexical-entity lookups and a headword # suffix compatibility transformation. Do not copy these unnoticed; offline experiment must disable network and retain literal identities.
Use stdin or argv arrays, never shell interpolation. The legacy CLI uses global state and fixed arrays; isolate process execution, bound input/output and fail explicitly on malformed XML.

aeolic_limits.finding: Source explicitly distinguishes AEOLIC and LESBIAN flags and has Aeolic-specific contraction/crasis rules. This is real dialect-aware morphology, not exclusively Attic parsing.
aeolic_limits.limits: Dialect flags are not proof of author attestation or exhaustive dialect coverage. Keep unlabelled/common alternatives; do not hard-filter everything by Alcaeus author label. Missing stems, editorial uncertainty and ambiguous analyses persist. Local deployment can improve availability/reproducibility, not guarantee better linguistic coverage than the same hosted engine/data.

proposed_bounded_experiment.build: Independent container build only, pinned Ubuntu22.04 base digest to record at authorization time, exact source revision+archive hash; gcc/make/flex-old. Build limits proposed1CPU/1GiB/timeout300s. Network only for explicit source/package acquisition in build stage, not parsing. Never add compiler or legacy C to current API image.
proposed_bounded_experiment.runtime_isolation: Separate container, network=none, nonrootUID1000, read-only rootfs and read-only executable/stem/input mounts, writable boundedtmpfs only; dropALL capabilities,no-new-privileges,pids_limit32,cpus0.5,memory256MiB,memory_swap256MiB. No Docker socket, credentials, live data/runtime mounts or published ports. These are initial safety caps to validate, not measured requirements.
proposed_bounded_experiment.execution_bounds: One serialized worker; at most64 input tokens per process, 10s wall timeout and1MiB output cap per batch, strict source token length and Beta Code validation. Preserve stderr/exit code and classify timeout, malformed output and no-analysis distinctly. No retry/letter repair or fallback to hosted service.
proposed_bounded_experiment.evaluation_inputs: Exact five Campbell records at runtime/campbell-assignment/campbell_assignment.jsonl (SHAafe89681c1641331f609120c6c3e81220d17280f87e31b3ee5f3aeda965a3e1b). Derive eligible whole-word forms with the existing source-barrier rules; preserve excluded fragmentary tokens explicitly. Compare the20 existing maintenance receipts (including elisions and the true negative) before broader clean-source coverage. Do not author test vocabulary or expected parses.
proposed_bounded_experiment.reference_note: Existing hosted receipts establish observed parity, not grammatical truth, and their deployed engine/stem revision is unknown. Canonical candidate comparisons exclude transport-specific receipt IDs but preserve lemma identities, POS/features, dialect tags, quantities and multiple alternatives.
success_gates: Independent audit of source/license/hash acquisition and exact copied source tokens before running downloaded code.
Build succeeds in isolated image; executable/compiler/baseimage/stem manifests and actual runtime deps are recorded.
No egress during parsing, no source text mutations, no unexplained parser crashes or candidate loss against cached references.
Every projected candidate points to raw local XML and pinnedengine+data+adapter receipts; new engine namespace cannot collide with alpheios-literal-v1 cache keys.
Measure recognized-form coverage, dictionaryjoin coverage, p50/p95/max latency and peakRSS separately from contextual accuracy.
No production imports or serving until independent output audit and a subsequent explicit deployment decision.
